name: Azure VM Lifecycle Survey
description: Pick which VMs to act on, choose allocate/deallocate, then run now or on a schedule. Pairs with azure_vm_lifecycle.yml. NOTE: the 'Hosts' choices are static — keep them in sync with the inventory (by hand or via an API refresh job).

spec.question_description: Select which VM(s) to allocate/deallocate. Leave none selected to target ALL discovered VMs. (Choices are maintained here; they do not auto-refresh from the inventory.)
Allocate (start), deallocate, or just report status.
Run the action now (adhoc) or create a recurring AAP schedule for it.
Name for the AAP Schedule. Only used when Run mode = schedule.
